interpretation_limits: The pointwise 95% low-context interval excludes zero, but it is exploratory and unadjusted for the nine variants, multiple metrics/periods and prior feature exploration. It is a serious consistency warning, not definitive proof of population harm.

The all 21 top 20 difference is negative in all three blocks, while its pooled 95% interval includes zero. Failure to establish improvement is not equivalence and does not prove every new feature is bad.

Gain is in-training split usage, not conditional causal contribution or test-period profit. Correlated features can substitute for one another; validity bits can be redundant for native-missing-value trees yet useful to median-imputed SVMs.

Five inputs have zero all-model Rank gain in all three windows. This proves only non-use by those fitted tree heads. Their SVM influence remains possible, and removing columns can change the 0.8 feature-subsampling path even at seed 0.
The continuous_only variant removes only four setup conjunction flags; it still includes the other binary validity/new-low indicators. It is not literally an all-continuous feature set.

Single fixed seed/configuration and repeated historical exploration leave algorithmic and selection uncertainty unmeasured. Do not tune new cutoffs on these outer outcomes or promote compact because it lost least.
Rank IC averages the full cross-section and does not guarantee better returns in the purchased top 20. Low-context mildly improved pooled IC while reducing top 20 returns.
The official-open benchmark is not guaranteed executable after observing the open. Constituent Low/Open statistics are not portfolio drawdown or an executable stop strategy.

what_pending_fit_resolves.decision_guidance: Finish the unchanged full 21-feature study honestly. A positive result would support only that full Fit configuration in that period, subject to source-quality qualifications; it would not reverse the Rank finding or validate the production configuration with 19 active new inputs. A negative or uncertain result gives no basis to claim a model improvement. Continue ordinary review and pruning without selecting a new winner from already observed outer outcomes. The two input-quality prunes do not require individual return attribution, which this experiment does not measure.

representation_findings.raw_formula_checks: All 15 frozen extreme examples reconstructed from original price bars to numerical tolerance. No demonstrated arithmetic bug. The ordinary persisted recovery distribution exactly matches the separately recomputed ordinary-price distribution.
representation_findings.recovery_source_caveat: The frozen SPCX ratio of 7,250 comes from a different ETF security before June 2026 and is absent from ordinary Yahoo history. The actual ordinary DKS extreme independently establishes the same representation problem.
representation_findings.volatility_normalization: Frozen largest two-day sigma value 171.42 and loss-change value 91.96 occur on recorded ASST price jumps with pre-shock volatility around 4.8–4.9%, not tiny denominators. A volatility floor is not established as the remedy by these examples. Confirm economic/corporate-action continuity before treating all extreme recorded moves as genuine.

data_quality_findings.evidence: HUBB and UHAL-B on 2026-02-25 volumes are 30/32 in ordinary Yahoo versus 367726.304487/330326.87178 in the independent Massive daily aggregate. Adjacent-session volumes closely agree.
data_quality_findings.severity: Concrete upstream data-quality problem that can affect existing volume features too. Temporary ratio pruning contains amplification but is not a source repair. No price or volume correction was applied.

data_quality_findings.evidence: Ordinary QH prior close 0.12 becomes Open 3.60 on 2026-04-27, with a preceding support near 0.017. Yahoo identifies Quhuo/NasdaqCM and reports the same 52-week low but no split-event entry in April 1–May 15. Massive returned no daily/action rows, dated reference 404 and no inactive Quhuo matches; issuer IR 403.
data_quality_findings.severity: Suspected action/security/adjustment issue, not a confirmed split. Do not invent a ratio adjustment, automatically remove QH, or prune all support fields to hide it. Limits economic interpretation of affected support/low examples and requires a separate data-quality resolution.
